description.value:
Duration constant

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would make you frightened, sickened, or stupefied.

cinderfall.incomplete: The sickened/stupefied clause has no clean predicate: unlike fear, neither sickened nor stupefied has a single universal pf2e trait covering their sources (sickened sources are frequently poison/disease-trait, not uniformly tagged; stupefied sources are frequently but not always mental-trait) -- no predicate covers "any effect that would impose sickened or stupefied" without also excluding real cases or including unintended ones.
